notes: Fixed violationLogRouteFor building '?section=violations' + '?workflowStatus=' (double '?' -> managerSectionFromLocation reads the whole tail as an invalid section value and falls back to Overview) by rebuilding all violation routes through one URLSearchParams-based helper (violationSectionRouteFor). Introduced view=create|log as a UI-state sub-param of section=violations (assets/js/checklist/phf-checklist-app.js) - Ghi nhan loi and Nhat ky loi are now two separate sidebar entries (manager: data-phfck-manager-violation-view; admin: data-phfck-view-workflow, kept out of ADMIN_VIEW_ROUTES/ADMIN_ROUTE_VIEWS entirely since two routes differing only by query would collide under those maps' cleanPath-keyed reverse lookup) instead of a tab hidden inside Ghi nhan loi. violationEffectiveView(path,canRecord) is the single resolver used by content dispatch, sidebar active-state and the create-without-permission downgrade - resolved at render time only, no history.replaceState, so back/forward is untouched. Fixed a duplicate-heading flash: violationLoadingHtml() unconditionally drew its own 'PHF CHECKLIST - ADMIN / Ghi nhan loi' page-head even when embedded inside the manager section's own managerSectionHeading, and violationsHtml()'s embeddedManager check read session-hydration-dependent role() instead of the URL-derived routeRole() the outer shell already used to pick manager vs admin - both now share one routeRole()-based source, and the loading view suppresses its page-head the same way the ready view does. initializeViolationsView also no longer runs the create-flow's people/template fetch when the resolved view is log (that fetch, and its showViolationLoading call, was unrelated to Nhat ky loi and caused the wrong loading screen to flash there).
